bio.text: Lori Wilson, a Democrat, represents the 11th Assembly District, which covers parts of Contra Costa, Sacramento and Solano counties, in the California State Assembly.
Her official website says she was elected in April 2022 and was previously Mayor of Suisun City, having first been elected to the city council in 2012.

According to the same page, she is a native Californian raised in Fresno, holds a bachelor's degree in business administration from California State University, Sacramento, and has lived in Suisun City since 2004.
